segments.t: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
I thank my God whenever I remember you,
segments.note: ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ μνείᾳ ὑμῶν を「whenever I remember you」とほぐす

segments.t: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
segments.note: τῇ κοινωνίᾳ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον を「your partnership in furtherance of the Good News」とほぐす

segments.t: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え。συγκοινωνούς μου τῆς χάριτος は「partakers with me of grace」

segments.t: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
segments.note: ἐν σπλάγχνοις Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ を「in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus」と訳す

segments.t: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
segments.note: τὰ διαφέροντα を「the things that are excellent」とほぐす

segments.t: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
segments.note: τὰ κατ᾽ ἐμέ を「the things which happened to me」とほぐす

segments.t: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（τοὺς δεσμούς μου φανεροὺς ἐν Χριστῷ γενέσθαι を文としてほぐす）。πραιτωρίῳ は「palace guard」

segments.t: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold
to speak the word
of God
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「of God」（τοῦ θεοῦ）を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: without fear.
Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文の節順に従い、この節にギリシャ語本文17節の内容（党争から説教する者たち）を置く。ギリシャ語本文16節（愛から説教する者たち）の訳は WEB の17節に現れるため、この節のギリシャ語トークンは対応なし

segments.t: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
segments.note: この節の英語はギリシャ語本文16節の内容（愛から説教する者たち）で、節順の入れ替えによる。ギリシャ語本文17節の内容は WEB の16節に現れるため、この節のギリシャ語トークンは対応なし

segments.t: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
segments.note: τί γάρ を「What does it matter?」とほぐす

segments.t: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
segments.note: τοῦτό μοι καρπὸς ἔργου を「this will bring fruit from my work」とほぐす

segments.t: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
segments.note: πολλῷ μᾶλλον κρεῖσσον を「far better」とほぐす

segments.t: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
segments.note: πολιτεύεσθε を「let your way of life be」とほぐす

segments.t: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（ἥτις ἐστὶν αὐτοῖς ἔνδειξις ἀπωλείας、ὑμῶν δὲ σωτηρίας）

segments.t: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
